identity_observation: Visible menu reads BUILD 81; source hash was supplied, not inspected.
method: Read only helper --help, then native JSON-lines touch input with at most two contacts. Every screenshot viewed before adaptive input. Planning map visibly closed with #close-map. No source/tests/docs/prior reviews/recordings/internal state inspected; no keyboard, mouse or evaluation used.

observed: Paused overview planning map and visible close
Hold USE careful movement and Mara recovery
Patrol fire, damage indicators and critical health
Dash activation attempt with visible cooldown

helpful_moments.observation: Two-column handbook gives concise movement, map, USE and objective sequence instructions within the landscape viewport.
Paused map shows known facility, player, selected memory and walking route; it made the west destination understandable.
Opening centered enemy disappeared after a held burst; clear first combat success.
Precise 0.9 m outside reach prompt explained why USE had not recovered the memory.
Stepping forward with USE then stopping recovered Mara, filled slot 01, and raised observed health from 73 to 90.

frustrating_moments.observation: Straight movement ended against induction cover; I had to strafe around it.
My first careful USE approach stopped outside reach while incoming fire depleted shield and health.
Combined diagonal movement and held fire-drag did not effectively address the side sentinel; health fell to 33. The short drag changed heading only from 000 to 005, leaving me poorly aligned.
Reload, movement, dash tap and firing left me at 14 health facing a largely blank obstructing wall, with only an edge PATH marker to guide escape.
Attempting rightward then forward escape ended in loss before the second memory.

scores.scale: 0 unusable, 5 mixed but playable with substantial friction, 10 exceptional. Subjective scores for this single synthetic attempt only; overall is holistic, not a completion score or arithmetic mean.

overall_mobile.reason: Coherent, readable and functional touch loop with one satisfying recovery, but combat/navigation coordination was difficult and the attempt ended quickly.

controls.reason: Movement, firing, reload and USE functioned. Aiming while moving and fitting dash into two-contact action were difficult for me; 6% accuracy limits any claim of effective combat control.

gameplay.reason: Clear memory objective, opening combat and recovery reward gave purpose. Side fire and cover routing overwhelmed me before later systems could be assessed.

presentation.reason: Consistent cyan/amber visual language, rain-lit station and polished menu/end screen; close cover views became visually uninformative.

usability.reason: Useful handbook, pausing map, route and explicit receiver reach feedback. Simultaneous navigation and combat required attention across many touch buttons.

readability.reason: Large health/ammo and objective are clear; handbook fits. Distance/status text, map detail and secondary end statistics are small at 844x390.

uncertainties: Poor combat accuracy may reflect my synthetic touch technique and unfamiliarity; this one run cannot isolate control design from reviewer skill.
Only one elimination is confirmed by terminal stats; firing success against later sentinels is unconfirmed.
Dash was tapped and cooldown observed, but no phase evade was credited.
Later mission balance and content were not reached.
limitations: Synthetic native-touch Chromium emulation, not a physical phone.
Software-WebGL fallback reported by helper; renderer not certified.
Captures pause the mission for inspection, and planning itself pauses. This materially reduces continuous pressure and prevents judging uninterrupted enjoyment.
Physical phones, Safari, audio, hardware performance and continuous enjoyment remain unassessed.

cleanup.result: Both exact owned PIDs absent after helper exit; no kill commands used.
